_comment: CANONICAL test-session prefix contract — story 125-10 (follow-up to 126-34). VENDORED BYTE-IDENTICAL in two repos: sidequest-server/tests/fixtures/test_session_prefix_contract.json and sidequest-ui/src/components/Dashboard/__tests__/fixtures/test_session_prefix_contract.json. To change the test-session prefixes, edit BOTH copies of this file AND both predicates (server: is_test_session in sidequest/telemetry/watcher_hub.py; ui: isTestSession in src/components/Dashboard/source/useLiveSource.ts). Each repo's contract test pins its predicate's declared prefix set to this file, so a one-sided predicate change fails that repo's CI.
